overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for hivolda: course_content, learning_outcomes (all three sub-groups kept), teaching_methods, coursework_requirements and prerequisites are correctly cut and clean in all 20 courses, including the 6 random controls. The only recurring defect is that assessment is a flattened one-line table row (form, duration, grade scale glued together). All 'leak' flags and the 'boilerplate' flag are false alarms or symptoms of that.

findings.evidence: Munnleg eksamen Individuell 30 minutt A-F, der A er best og E er siste ståkarakter
findings.description: Assessment in every course is a flattened table row on one line with no cell separators: exam form, grouping, duration, grade scale, weight and aids run together (e.g. '... ståkarakter 100 Studenten skal ved registrering i Studentweb velje ...' in SA1B 2019, or a trailing 'Ingen' for aids in SA2A). Duration and grade scale are exam logistics. The content is complete and correctly placed; the identical 'Munnleg eksamen Individuell 30 minutt A-F ...' text repeated across the MA2B courses is what trips the pre-pass 'boilerplate' flag (a symptom, not boilerplate: it is the real exam form).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Vurderingsform table is read as a single text line by the block reader for hivolda (R/blocks.R / section_* config in R/institution_config.R); the table header row is already dropped, but cells are not separated.
findings.suggested_fix: Emit table cells with a separator (e.g. ' | ') for hivolda's assessment table in R/blocks.R, and optionally strip the fixed grade-scale phrase 'A-F, der A er best og E er siste ståkarakter' and the 'Studentweb' registration sentence in .clean_sections().
